title: Institute of Chin Affairs Reports 1,300+ Killed in Chin State Since Coup
detail: The Institute of Chin Affairs reported that more than 1,300 civilians and resistance fighters have been killed in Chin State since the February 2021 coup through August 2026. Airstrikes accounted for 482 of those deaths, including 306 civilians, among them 45 children under age 10.

media.caption: MoeMaKa CDM domestic news digest citing the Institute of Chin Affairs cumulative casualty report.

title: Two Civilians Killed by Junta-Laid Landmine in Salin Township, Magway Region
detail: Two civilians died after stepping on a landmine planted by junta forces near Nyaung Kone Shar village, Salin Township, Magway Region. The incident was reported in MoeMaKa's September 22, 2026 domestic news digest; the exact date of the incident was not specified.

media.caption: MoeMaKa CDM domestic news digest reporting a landmine incident near Nyaung Kone Shar village, Salin Township.

title: UN Secretary-General Warns Myanmar Crisis Risks 'Slipping From Global Attention' at UNGA
detail: Addressing the opening of the General Debate of the 81st UN General Assembly session on September 22, 2026, Secretary-General António Guterres warned that the crisis in Myanmar is at risk of slipping from the world's attention despite escalating violence, mass displacement and expanding transnational crime spilling across its borders. Guterres grouped Myanmar with the Middle East, Ukraine and Sudan as crises where declared ceasefires have often amounted to little more than 'lesser fires,' with civilians continuing to pay the price.

media.caption: UN News coverage of Secretary-General Guterres' UNGA address warning Myanmar risks slipping from global attention.

title: 38 LPDF Fighters and Family Members Surrender in Saltan Area, Sagaing Region
detail: A group of 38 people affiliated with a Local People's Defence Force (LPDF) unit — 29 men, 3 women, and 6 family members — surrendered to junta forces in the Saltan area, Sagaing Region, on September 22, 2026, handing over 13 weapons.

media.caption: MoeMaKa CDM domestic news digest reporting the LPDF surrender in the Saltan area.
